jobs.title: Global Practioner
jobs.text: Joining Collibra’s Global Practitioner team Collibra is seeking an experienced and dynamic leader to join our Global Practitioner team with a focus on Data Quality. This role is central to ensuring our prospects and customers maximize their investment by providing guidance, strategic consulting, and proven best practices to build data quality programs that make data trustworthy at scale. If you are passionate about driving business value through reliable, high-quality data, we encourage you to apply. Global Practitioners at Collibra are responsible for Strategic advisory - Provide practical, expert guidance to executive stakeholders and program leaders to define, build, and sustain high-value Data Quality programs, including operating models, ownership, and the business case for trusted data. Rules, monitoring, and observability - Advise customers on designing effective data quality rules, quality dimensions and scoring, monitoring and alerting, and data observability practices that catch issues before they reach the business. Remediation and continuous improvement - Help customers establish issue detection, triage, and remediation workflows, connecting data quality findings to clear ownership, root-cause analysis, and measurable improvement over time. Data reliability at scale - Guide the integration of data quality into pipelines, data products, and governance workflows so reliability is built in rather than bolted on. Facilitation and enablement - Design and lead high-impact customer workshops on topics including data quality strategy, use case prioritization, rule and metric design, roles and stewardship, and adoption. Maturity assessment - Execute comprehensive Data Quality Maturity Assessments to benchmark customer capabilities and formulate clear, phased roadmaps for improvement. Thought leadership - Develop, curate, and share cutting-edge data quality best practices and compelling customer success stories across the Collibra ecosystem. You have Minimum of 3 years of experience as a Data Quality Program Leader, Data Reliability/Governance Program Manager, or equivalent senior-level role. Minimum of 2 years of direct, hands-on experience as a key Champion or Stakeholder of Collibra Data Quality & Observability. Practical fluency in core data quality concepts, quality dimensions, rule design, DQ scoring, monitoring and alerting, data observability, and remediation workflows. Proven ability to engage customers in a highly consultative manner, establishing immediate credibility and fostering long-term strategic relationships. Exceptional presentation and facilitation skills, with the ability to command and influence a room of diverse stakeholders, from technical teams to executive leadership. Superior written and verbal communication skills, capable of articulating complex concepts clearly and persuasively. A bachelor’s degree or equivalent related working experience is required. Demonstrated proficiency in leveraging AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, Copilot) to solve real-world business challenges, drive measurable outcomes, or streamline workflows. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Strong ability to discover and work with use cases to help customers implement solutions. This process requires reflective listening, capturing the essence of the problem, and offering a proposed solution. Ability to read and write Structured Query Language (“SQL”) in the context of DQ rules. Understanding of data outliers, patterns, duplicates, and valid values (ranges, etc.). Understanding of the core data quality dimensions. Ability to read and write data quality rule logic (e.g. comparing multiple columns in a single dataset, or even comparing multiple datasets). Ability to leverage an existing SQL function library function for use by a DQ rule (eg. length(‘Collibra’) ) Ability to invoke an existing REST API endpoint, and the basics of HTTP: GET , and POST . Ability to work with boolean logic operators AND , OR , and NOT. Basic ability to navigate a Linux operating system and filesystem (eg. cd , pwd , ls , etc.). Ability to understand and explain how Apache Spark works with data, at a high level, is a plus (not required). This is for DQ “pull up.” Ability to understand how Kubernetes (K8s) and Docker containers work is a plus (not required). Ability to read and write Python code is a plus (not required). jobs.title: Director of Privacy and Data Governance
jobs.text: Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI. What is the Role? Reporting to our VP of Business Integrity, we are seeking a seasoned privacy attorney to serve as Director of Privacy and Data Governance. This position is ideal for a strategic and collaborative subject matter expert with experience leading a team of attorneys. This is an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic, fully distributed global enterprise and foster the continued development of its global privacy program. We will consider applicants in the United States or Europe. What You Will Be Doing: Lead the Privacy and Data Governance program, providing strategic direction and insights to support a business-forward, innovative and risk-based approach. Lead a team of three skilled privacy professionals who are tasked with the operation of Elastic’s privacy processes and controls. Advise senior management and other stakeholders on privacy and data protection-related matters, including strategies for mitigating privacy related risks, ensuring compliance with legal requirements and best practices regarding data governance. Foster privacy compliance and awareness across the company, including in product development, procurement, HR, finance, legal, sales, marketing, and other areas. Collaborate cross-functionally to develop and implement a risk-based AI governance framework relating to Elastic’s use of AI within its operations. Maintain subject matter expertise in applicable foreign and domestic regulations pertaining to privacy, data governance, AI, and data security and how they impact Elastic’s operations or products. Support the product, customer-facing and supplier-facing legal teams with legal advice related to privacy, security, and data governance-related contract terms. Advise on cybersecurity-related inquiries, audits, and incidents. What You Bring: Candidates must have at least 8 years of legal experience specific to privacy, with preference for those who also have at least 3 years of in-house experience in a managerial role. Candidates must have experience overseeing the operational aspects of a privacy and data governance program. Candidates must be able to solve complex legal and business challenges that have significant impact on the organization by anticipating potential legal issues, offering solutions and leading execution of those solutions. Candidates must successfully communicate complex legal concepts and strategies to senior management, fostering alignment between legal decisions and business strategy. Candidates must be proactive , able to exercise independent judgment, and work effectively on cross-functional teams. Candidates must demonstrate a strong sense of ownership and be comfortable in a dynamic and evolving environment. Candidates must exhibit excellent judgment, character, and professional integrity. Candidates must be actively licensed to practice law. Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component. In select locations (including Seattle WA, Los Angeles CA, the San Francisco Bay Area CA, and the New York City Metro Area), an alternate range may apply as specified below. These ranges represent the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the ranges may be modified in the future. An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs. jobs.title: Information Security Controls Manager - Cloud & AI Governance
jobs.text: About the opportunity We are seeking an Information Security Controls Manager to join the Information Risk Management (IRM) Segment within the Information Security (IS) Controls team at N26. As a member of this team, you will contribute to ensuring that Information Security Controls Framework processes are operated without any disruptions, with a specialized focus on strengthening our Cloud Security posture and AI Governance frameworks. N26 and its subsidiaries operate in a variety of regulatory environments and across international boundaries, while the IRM team helps N26 to navigate this complex, demanding, and rapidly evolving technological landscape. In this role, you will: Frequently communicate with various stakeholders of all levels. Execution and review of the Information Security (IS) Controls Framework monitoring process, ensuring comprehensive coverage of cloud infrastructure and AI/ML deployments. Communicate, Collate and review the evidence received via monthly control review request tickets (TOE). Perform QA reviews, query and or seek clarification from stakeholders to achieve the objectives of controls effectiveness. Highlight the gaps/risks observed during reviews, raise non-conformities, particularly concerning cloud misconfigurations and AI model risks, and suggest improvements to the teams or stakeholders. Liaise with the CISO office and the DPO office to provide updates on a monthly basis over the status of controls, including compliance updates regarding cloud security and AI systems. Improve awareness of controls, security practices, and responsible AI utilization among stakeholders. Contribute to the team in developing KRIs tailored to traditional IT, Cloud environments, and AI use cases. Working independently and managing the IS Controls daily tasks. Review and update the design of the controls pages from a technical perspective and maintain the control calendar. Actively work on the change requests from stakeholders. Preparation and follow-up of Change Request tickets. Drafting and publishing of the monthly control reports & other documentation (MoMs). Support the team and stakeholders during audits and coordinating the action items and evidence. Maintain controls team’s key documentation to ensure audit readiness. Equally participate in designing controls, developing working instructions and procedures that are required based on security standards and regulations such as ISO 27001, EU GDPR, DORA, SWIFT, NIS2, and the EU AI Act. Evaluate and map internal control frameworks to cloud security benchmarks (e.g., Cloud Security Alliance (CSA), BSI C5) and AI governance frameworks. Facilitate and make sure that all key processes have been documented in an easy and efficient process flow. Design and update working instructions to implement the requirements coming from the policies. Identify and surface process or tooling-related inefficiencies and support AI enabled process optimizations Mapping of Internal control framework to the various regulations/Standards. What you need to be successful: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, relevant to information security or computer science. You have approximately 4-6 years of experience in an information security compliance, risk, or audit role. Demonstrated experience or strong knowledge of Cloud Security controls (AWS/Google Cloud preferred) and AI/ML governance risk frameworks. Previous hands-on experience or knowledge on security standards such as ISO 27001, ISO42001, NIST, BSI C5 , and other regulatory requirements like DORA, EU AI Act , EU CRA & EU GDPR. Good understanding of Information & Communication Technologies (ICT) and Security controls. Previous experience related to audit/compliance frameworks and methodologies is a plus. Ability to communicate clearly with peers, as well as stakeholders of all levels. You are proficient in using Jira, Confluence and Google Workspace apps. (i.e. Docs, Sheets, Slides). Good understanding of Google Sheets features and formulas. Previous experience with Compliance tools is a plus (i.e. ServiceNow, OneTrust..). Ability to analyze and evaluate documentation, reports, data, flowcharts etc., for IT processes such as system development, cloud infrastructure management, and IT operations. Fluency in English is strictly required. German proficiency is a plus. jobs.title: AI Enablement Manager
jobs.text: Joining Collibra's Talent Management & Development team AI is fundamentally reshaping how organizations operate. At Collibra, we believe realizing the value of AI requires more than great technology, it depends on how confidently people adopt it and apply it in their everyday work. Building the skills, confidence and mindset to work alongside AI will be critical to how we innovate, collaborate and create value for customers. We're looking for an AI Enablement Manager who is passionate about helping employees confidently adopt AI and identify practical opportunities to rethink the way work gets done. You'll combine strong hands-on AI experience with coaching, enablement and learning to help employees integrate AI into their workflows and accelerate AI adoption across the business. Reporting to the Director of Talent Management & Development, you'll lead our AI enablement initiatives, partner closely with Product & Engineering, and help teams identify opportunities to use AI, rethink the way work gets done, and adopt new ways of working. This is a hybrid role based in our Brussels office. Our hybrid model means you’ll work from the office at least two days each week. This setup helps us stay connected, work more closely together, and keep making progress as a team. jobs.title: Engagement Manager
jobs.text: Joining Collibra’s Professional Services team As an Engagement Manager, you will own and direct the full engagement life cycle for customers purchasing Collibra services, working across multiple customer personas,industries, departments, and internal Collibra functions to lead project delivery and influence customer success and adoption of the Collibra Platform. This role is instrumental in driving renewal and expansion by accelerating time to value, increasing adoption, and influencing product strategy with valuable learnings all of which drive Collibra's growth This is a hybrid role based in our London office. Our hybrid model means you’ll work from the office at least two days each week. This setup helps us stay connected, work more closely together, and keep making progress as a team. Enterprise Engagement Managers at Collibra are responsible for Overseeing the successful installation, configuration, and initial operation of Collibra's products and technologies for new and existing customers. Developing ingagement plans and being accountable for informing and advising client representatives and internal stakeholders of planning, progress, risks, and issues. Ensuring services delivery across geographic territories is in full compliance with the established Collibra engagement model, processes, methodologies, and artifacts. Partnering effectively with Collibra Professional Services Architects, Sales Leads, Account, Product Management, and Customer Support teams. Partnering with Collibra Professional Services Architects to define and implement an operating model specific to the customer's use cases, technical go-live, and production go-live needs. Chairing regular engagement review meetings with customers and with internal Collibra teams, and facilitating the smooth and timely running of workshops and training to support Collibra revenue targets. You have 5+ years of consulting management experience working directly with customers, ideally within SaaS environments. A proven track record of delivering multiple projects and related outcomes simultaneously on time, on budget, and to quality. The ability to build customer relationships and deliver presentations to all levels of business and IT stakeholders. Knowledge of core data management or data governance technologies (a plus). Proficient language skills in English (mandatory); German or Dutch preferred. At least a bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in a business, technical, or related field. Demonstrated proficiency in leveraging AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, Copilot) to solve real-world business challenges, drive measurable outcomes, or streamline workflows. A bachelor’s degree or equivalent related working experience is required You are Customer focused, placing customer success at the highest priority. Eager to learn, embrace, and improve upon new processes. A team player, you are at ease to synchronize with a high velocity of internal and external stakeholders. A role model to the broader teams for engagement management best practices, processes, and creative problem solving. At ease to facilitate and liaise between internal and external stakeholders. Ability to deliver projects for multiple customers simultaneously Eligible to work in London. Measures of success Within your first month, you will gain a fundamental knowledge of the Collibra Products, Services offerings and services delivery processes and procedures. Within your third month, you will manage assigned services engagements with considerable supervision and management required as you continue to ramp. Within your sixth month, you will manage assigned services engagements with minimal supervision and management required.
